/* Query lookup data for the foreign key(s) */
DECLARE
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN

 :DECLARATIONS.TYPE_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.TYPE_NAME. */
 ,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD); /* IN : Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 --CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 NULL;
 END;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'DECLARATIONS', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;
 IF (name_in('DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF NOT (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD = 6) AND NOT (:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :DCLTN_STA_CD = 8) THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;
 ELSE
 IF :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IS NOT NULL AND :PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_INST'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_CMPTR'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DU_MGR')) THEN
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD := :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_STA_CD
 FROM DCLTN_SUSPNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ORDER BY SUSPN_SEQ DESC
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_DESC /* MOD: Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_DESC. */

 EXCEPTION

 END IF;
EXCEPTION

 NULL;

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DECLARATIONS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$LOV_DCLTN_INS_GLOBALS.DECLARATIONS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$LOV_DCLTN_INS_GLOBALS.DECLARATIONS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$LOV_DCLTN_INS_GLOBALS.DECLARATIONS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DECLARATIONS.TYPE_NAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(TYPE_NAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(TYPE_NAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(TYPE_NAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(TYPE_NAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((DCLTN_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT TYPE_ID '||'FROM DCLTN_TYPES WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((DCLTN_STA_CD, DCLTN_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT DCLTN_STA_CD, DCLTN_TYPE_CD '||'FROM DCLTN_STATUS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;
